query: SELECT GREATEST(resource.created, (SELECT COALESCE(created_at, TO_TIMESTAMP(0)) FROM container_registry_repository_manifest WHERE repository_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1), (SELECT COALESCE(last_updated, TO_TIMESTAMP(0)) FROM container_registry_repository_tag WHERE repository_id = $1 ORDER BY last_updated DESC LIMIT 1)) AS "last_updated!" FROM resource WHERE resource.id = $1;
